MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.20 · Owl light, system status and Codex usage

See owl light, system metrics, Codex usage and continuously updated overtime.

Latest public release2026-10-26
Mac DMGMac ZIP

macOS 13 or later · Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel

HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Mac 1.5.20 adds optional System Runner and AI usage modules. Core attendance works independently.

The owl’s eyes stay fixed while rim light rotates at a speed controlled by CPU usage. Choose start/end colors or a hamster, rabbit or cat. See CPU, memory use/pressure, startup-disk capacity, physical-network receive/transmit speed and battery together.

Show a Codex ChatGPT account’s weekly remaining limit, reset time and hourly burn rate. Choose Codex text plus percentage, a monochrome icon plus percentage, or percentage only. This is not API cost or model token usage. Enable System Runner after installation; Codex Show usage is off by default.

Show expected departure in menu bar remains on by default. When on, it shows Leave 18:00 · 91 min left; when off, 91 min left. Changes apply immediately and survive restart. During the first 30 minutes after departure, it shows only the expected departure time or Ready to leave; after that elapsed overtime updates.

Improvements

  • Elapsed overtime updates in your selected unit from 30 minutes after expected departure: every second for normal units, every 0.1 seconds for milliseconds, rounded down to completed units. The 120-minute meal reference stays unchanged.
  • More (…) offers Settings and Quit; usage rows open the corresponding plugin settings.
  • On macOS 26 and later, existing themes also use glass surfaces, an arrowless panel and a new settings title bar. Native Liquid Glass follows system colors. Older macOS, Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast use the existing or opaque fallback.
  • The app stays responsive while waiting for DaouOffice Keychain access; stale work cannot apply after connection settings change.

Support and verification scope

Requires macOS 13 or later; Apple Silicon and Intel Universal. The latest public Windows release remains 1.5.13 and does not include these runner, Codex or panel changes. The app identifier, record path and saved connection settings remain unchanged.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. Local installation, relaunch and version display on the author’s Mac were checked. Calendar connections/permissions, company-account round trips, VoiceOver, external Macs, physical Intel devices and reboot login remain separately unverified.

Downloads

The attached signed release notes record the candidate creation stage. Their candidate/preparation and previous-public-version wording is historical; the current public release is Mac 1.5.20 build36.

Quit the existing app and move the app from the DMG or ZIP into the same location. Keep record and connection files.
